resources.string: Share your records with named people, revocably, with no server in the middle. Off by default; reads only, and never writes to the loop.
Show the code someone scans to start following you

Show this to someone who should be able to follow you. It is not a secret: it holds a public key and an address, and anyone who has it can download your data and read none of it. They still cannot open anything until you add their key below.
Nothing to share yet. Turn Swarm sharing on and wait for the first records to be sealed — an invite needs both your key and somewhere to reach you.
Paste the key they gave you. They will be able to read your whole history.
Paste their key. Takes effect immediately — but they keep whatever they already downloaded.
The people you have shared with
To stop sharing with someone, copy their key above and paste it into “Stop sharing with”.
Nobody. Use “Share with someone” to add a key.
